item.title: 🔴 Mount Royal University confirms breach as hackers claim attack
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — check monitoring and incident response readiness.
Mount Royal University in Calgary says hackers stole and then deleted data from its file storage systems after breaching the university's network. [...]
